source.title: Personal Heuristics and Obsidian Vault Notes
source.author: Curator

primitives.name: EmotionalSkepticism
primitives.definition: Treating acute urgency, dread, or fear as physiological signals rather than facts or prognoses.

primitives.name: DignifiedAvowal
primitives.definition: Expressing vulnerable capacity limits calmly without explosive anger or silent sulking.

primitives.name: DisposableExecution
primitives.definition: Taking small, rough, disposable actions while scared instead of waiting for confidence or mastery.

primitives.name: DeterministicContracts
primitives.definition: Enforcing strict schemas and single-purpose modules over open-ended probabilistic loops.

core_idea: High-agency living requires prioritizing physiological regulation over cognitive rationalization, dignified vulnerability over defensive retaliation, and deterministic execution over speculative perfectionism.

directional_heuristics.over: Defending your reputation or proving you are right
directional_heuristics.because: Pride-driven disputes waste energy and create enemies for zero ROI unless actual money or an essential relationship is directly on the line
directional_heuristics.when: Navigating an escalating public argument or conflict

directional_heuristics.prioritize: Buying 90 seconds and treating emotions with robust skepticism
directional_heuristics.over: Immediately analyzing or acting on the urgent feeling
directional_heuristics.because: An impression is not a prognosis, fear is not a fact, and feelings above a 5/10 are old emotional tracks projecting onto the present
directional_heuristics.when: Feeling acute anxiety, panic, or urge to react in a personal or professional relationship

directional_heuristics.prioritize: Making a calm, dignified avowal of limited bandwidth and vulnerable state
directional_heuristics.over: Dramatic severance, icy isolation, or tactical ghosting
directional_heuristics.because: Extreme detachment escalates drama while clear, non-negotiable structural schedules preserve integrity
directional_heuristics.when: Setting boundaries with a draining or volatile collaborator or friend

directional_heuristics.prioritize: Translating anger through the Honest, Kind, and Polite filter by naming vulnerable fears and needs directly
directional_heuristics.because: Sulking is a game expecting mind-reading, and anger triggers immediate defensive walls
directional_heuristics.when: Communicating difficult feedback, hurt, or unmet expectations

directional_heuristics.prioritize: Doing it scared with small, ugly, disposable actions
directional_heuristics.over: Waiting for emotional regulation, confidence, or comprehensive mastery
directional_heuristics.because: Emotions are physiological signals that follow action rather than precede it
directional_heuristics.when: Facing high uncertainty, dread, or intimidation in starting a project or difficult conversation

directional_heuristics.prioritize: The good enough framework with calibrated, progressive disclosure
directional_heuristics.over: Demanding perfect soulmate alignment or zero-friction compatibility
directional_heuristics.because: Compatibility is the hard-won ongoing achievement of adulthood rather than a magical starting condition

directional_heuristics.prioritize: Deterministic structural contracts and tiny tuned lenses
directional_heuristics.over: Giant catch-all mega-prompts and autonomous multi-agent swarms
directional_heuristics.because: Probabilistic loops without hard schema gates compound errors and produce unfocused hype-slop
directional_heuristics.when: Designing AI workflows or knowledge tools

directional_heuristics.over: Waiting for the other person to notice and pursue you
directional_heuristics.because: People rarely chase silence and silence gets filled with invented catastrophe
directional_heuristics.when: A close relationship is in silent tension or distance
